title: Machine learning-based risk prediction model development for acute kidney injury in type 2 myocardial infarction patients
summary: Methods analyze 1,378 MIMIC-IV type-2 myocardial-infarction ICU patients with a held-out 30% test set; Results report AKI incidence and model discrimination. Evidence is retrospective and bounded to this cohort.
ai_technology: The abstract reports a held-out acute-kidney-injury risk model for a defined myocardial-infarction cohort with measured test discrimination. The Methods specify the learned operation used for this case-specific result.
